'''2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals Alan Sagan Hoth North Ridge DS Regional Winner''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Alan Sagan]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals]]. The post is titled 'Hoth North Ridge DS Regional Winner' (posted 24 August 2000); Alan Sagan won the 2000 Hoth North Ridge Regionals on 5 August 2000. The post itself gives no record.<ref name="dt-9814">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9814 Hoth North Ridge DS Regional Winner], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 24 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9814/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9814/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018131028/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9814/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Hoth North Ridge DS Regional Winner'''
* '''Author:''' Alan "Serpent" Sagan
* '''Published:''' August 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Tie Ins in space.  Retrieval, drains, and beats.  what more do you need?

=== Strategy ===

This is a tie deck.  yeehaw.

Start the Set your course stuff, and pull wakeelmui first turn if it's not in your opening hand. Twi'lek or deploy Sienar Fleet Systems (almost always within the first two turns) and drop a tie to wakeelmui.  Next, I drop one to the docking bay to satisfy Battle Order.

If they come to beat up my tie at the docking bay, so what. deploy one there every turn, sac it to the used pile.  I never had a problem paying for my drains if I didn't satisfy battle order.	If you do have a problem, deploy 3 or more ties there.

Try to lure them into space....  Put enough ships at systems so you won't get totally shmucked, but not enough to make them not want to come to fight.  then when they hit you, twi'lek or play lateral damage, and then beat the crap out of em. chances are (almost every time) they lose 20+ cards.

don't forget your retrieval  retrieve 3 for the squadrons, and use Return to Base to get them back out for another 3 force.

The asteroid is to recycle ties... I know it's hard to kill em, they must draw a 4 for the squadrons, a 5 for ties, but in todays high destiny world, that'll happen probaly at LEAST every 3rd turn.

merrejk is great, drop him at the docking bay, pull a system. immune to battle damage.

3 twi'leks almost guarantee me the effects I want. I'm never hurting for lateral damage, Sienar fleet, Dreaded Starfleet, or whatever.

I'd change well guarded for first strike.  If they come to your docking bay, your gonna start causing them damage.

I picked the Vengeance as a star destroyer choice because it's a destiny 2 (3, oppresive enforcment) and holds 6 ties, which HAS come in usefull.  mostly cause of those squadrons.
